name: @kdcllc/ollama-model-manager
description: CLI and web UI for managing local Ollama models with hardware-aware recommendations and optimization guidance

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.public.json && mkdir -p dist/public && cp public/index.html public/styles.css dist/public/
scripts.start:build: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch public --ext ts,css,html,json --exec "npm run build && node dist/src/server.js"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run build
